recipes.name: Scrambled Egg & Black Bean Burritos

ingredients.name: bell pepper, any color, cut into 1/2-inch dice
canned black beans, drained and rinsed
shredded reduced-fat Mexican blend or Cheddar cheese

instructions: Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add the bell pepper and cook, stirring often, until softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. If the peppers begin to brown too quickly, reduce the heat to low to prevent burning.
Place the eggs and milk in a mixing bowl and whisk until combined. Stir in the beans, cheese, and smoked paprika.
When the peppers are done, add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil. Add the egg mixture and cook, stirring often, until the eggs are set and the cheese melts, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Place the warmed tortillas on plates or a work surface. Divide the egg mixture between the tortillas. Top each with the yogurt, salsa, and cilantro.
Fold in the sides and roll up burrito-style. Slice in half and serve warm.

recipes.name: Cranberry Carrot Muffins
instructions: Place the dried cranberries in a small bowl and cover with warm water. Let soak for 5 to 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Toss with 1 teaspoon of the flour.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line 6 muffin cups with parchment or foil cupcake liners and set aside.
Place the remaining 1 cup flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a medium bowl and whisk until well combined.
Place the egg, carrot, apple, oil, milk, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract in a separate medium bowl and whisk until combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir with a silicone spatula until just combined. Fold in the cranberries.

For the topping, place the brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and stir to combine. Spoon the batter evenly into the prepared muffin cups and add topping. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer the muffins to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Blueberry Banana Pancakes

ingredients.name: maple syrup, plus more for drizzling
fresh or frozen blueberries, plus more for topping

instructions: Place the flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a large bowl and whisk to combine.

Place the egg, milk, banana, and maple syrup in a separate medium bowl and whisk until combined. Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Stir in the blueberries.

Lightly oil or coat a large nonstick skillet or griddle with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium-low heat. Pour the batter onto the skillet using a generous 1/4-cup measuring cup, forming 3 1/2- to 4-inch pancakes.

Cook until bubbles begin to appear on the surface of the pancakes and the bottoms turn golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook until the other side is golden, an additional 2 to 3 minutes. Adjust the heat if the skillet gets too hot. Repeat with the remaining cooking spray and batter.
Top with additional maple syrup and blueberries, as desired.

recipes.name: Cheesy Egg, Bacon & Broccoli Muffins

ingredients.name: frozen broccoli florets, thawed, drained, squeezed dry, and finely chopped
turkey bacon, cooked and finely chopped
green onion, trimmed and finely chopped
dried Italian seasoning or dried basil

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray, making sure to coat the bottoms and sides well.

Place the eggs in a large bowl and whisk until well combined and slightly frothy. Add the broccoli, turkey bacon, 1/2 cup of the shredded cheese, green onion, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Divide the mixture evenly among the muffin cups, about 1/4 cup per muffin. You should have approximately 3 cups total egg mixture.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese evenly over the tops of the muffins. Top each with half a cherry tomato, cut-side up or down.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until puffed, lightly golden, and set in the center.
Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around the edges to loosen. Transfer the muffins to a wire rack to cool completely or serve while still warm.

recipes.name: Glorious Green Smoothie Bowl

ingredients.name: medium-size ripe banana, sliced and frozen
optional toppings: whole grain O-shaped oat cereal, chopped apple, dried cranberries, blueberries, or fresh mint

instructions: Place the orange juice, banana, spinach, yogurt, and cucumber in a high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into a bowl, add toppings as desired, and serve.

recipes.name: Sesame-Ginger Turkey Meatballs

ingredients.name: green onions, trimmed and finely chopped
finely chopped fresh cilantro or mint
panko breadcrumbs, plus more if needed
less-sodium teriyaki sauce or Gyoza dipping sauce

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray well with nonstick cooking spray to prevent the turkey meatballs from sticking.
Place the grated carrot, green onions, cilantro, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, salt, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl, and mix well to combine.
Add the ground turkey and panko. Mix gently until just combined. If the mixture feels too wet to roll, add 1 to 2 tablespoons of additional panko. Form into 16 meatballs, about 2 inches in diameter.
Arrange the meatballs on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes, turning once halfway through, until cooked through and no longer pink in the center.
Meanwhile, whisk the teriyaki sauce and cornstarch in a small bowl. Pour into a small saucepan or nonstick skillet over low heat and stir constantly until bubbling and thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Transfer the cooked meatballs to a serving bowl. Top with the sauce and gently stir to coat. Garnish with the orange zest, and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken and Broccoli Piccata
instructions: Place 3 tablespoons of the cornstarch, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl and stir to combine. Coat the chicken tenders in the mixture, pressing gently so the cornstarch adheres to all sides. Set aside on a plate.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes, or until golden. Flip and cook for an additional 2 minutes, adjusting the heat if the chicken browns too quickly. Work in batches if needed. Transfer the chicken to a clean plate.
Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, stir in the red onion, and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Raise the heat to medium. Add the water and broccoli, cover with a lid, and steam for 2 minutes, just until the broccoli is crisp-tender.

Stir the remaining 2 teaspoons of cornstarch into the broth until well combined. Add the broth mixture, lemon juice, and capers to the skillet. Raise the heat to medium-high and cook, stirring often, until the sauce gently simmers and begins to thicken, about 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet. Cook for 3 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through, until heated through and the sauce reduces slightly. Sprinkle with lemon zest and serve warm.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas with Lime Sauce

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2-inch strips
medium bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch strips
medium red onion, cut into 1/2-inch wedges
packed fresh cilantro, plus more for garnish

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and lightly coat with nonstick spray. Set aside.
Place the chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, and garlic powder in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Place the chicken, bell peppers, and onion in a separate large bowl and toss to combine. Add the olive oil and spice blend and stir until everything is evenly coated.

Spread the mixture in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. For added char, switch to broil during the last 2 to 3 minutes, if desired.

Before serving, stack the tortillas loosely on a microwave-safe plate, cover with a slightly damp paper towel, and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds, or until warm. Or, wrap in foil and warm in the oven for 5 minutes.
To make the sauce, place all sauce ingredients in a mini food processor or blender and blend until smooth. Season with salt to taste.
To assemble, place the cooked chicken, vegetables, and sauce on each tortilla. Garnish with extra cilantro and a squeeze of lime, as desired.

recipes.name: One-Pot Beef & Mushroom Lasagna

ingredients.name: lean ground beef, 90% lean or higher
water, divided, plus more as needed
dry no-boil lasagna noodles, broken into 1-inch pieces
roughly chopped fresh basil, plus more to taste
red pepper flakes, plus more to taste

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large saucepan over low heat. Add the mushrooms and a pinch of salt and pepper and cook, stirring often, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the remaining oil. Raise the heat to medium and stir in the carrots, beef, garlic powder, and onion powder. Cook, breaking the beef into small pieces, until no longer pink, 3 to 5 minutes.

Raise the heat to high. Stir in the marinara sauce. Add 1 1/2 cups water to the pot. Pour the remaining 1 cup water into the empty sauce jar and shake to loosen any remaining sauce. Pour into the pot and stir to combine.
Cover and bring the mixture to a boil. Gradually stir in the broken lasagna noodles to prevent sticking.

Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the pasta is tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Stir every 3 to 5 minutes to prevent sticking to the bottom and ensure even cooking. For a saucier consistency, stir in an additional 1/4 cup water during the final minutes.

Remove from the heat and stir in the basil and red pepper flakes. Stir in 3/4 cup of the mozzarella and the Parmesan. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella on top. Cover for 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Serve warm and add additional basil or red pepper flakes, as desired.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Dijon Gravy
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Heat the oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Season all sides of the pork with the rosemary, salt, and pepper, and add to the hot skillet, browning for 2 to 3 minutes on all sides.

Transfer pork to a rimmed baking sheet, and bake until a meat thermometer registers 145°F, 12 to 15 minutes. Remove to a clean plate. Cover with aluminum foil, and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, return the skillet to medium heat. Add the broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the mustard, garlic, and thyme, and let the sauce reduce by about a third, stirring often.
Remove the sauce from heat, and stir in the butter until slightly thickened.
Cut the pork into slices, and serve with the sauce.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos with Crunchy Slaw

ingredients.name: white fish, such as cod or tilapia
fresh cilantro or parsley, roughly chopped
optional toppings: diced tomato, plain Greek yogurt or sour cream, cilantro
nonstick cooking spray or parchment paper

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet or shallow baking dish with aluminum foil and lightly coat with nonstick cooking spray, or line with parchment paper. Set aside.
Place the oregano, chili powder, garlic powder, paprika, and salt in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels. Place on the prepared baking sheet and brush evenly with the olive oil. Top with the spice mixture.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the fish flakes and is cooked through.
For the slaw, place all the ingredients in a large bowl and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Before serving, stack the tortillas loosely on a microwave-safe plate, cover with a slightly damp paper towel, and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds, or until warm. Or, wrap in foil and warm in the oven for 5 minutes.
To assemble, place the cooked fish, slaw, avocado, and optional toppings, as desired, on each tortilla.

recipes.name: Chicken Sausage Garden Pasta

ingredients.name: cooked Italian chicken sausage, cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds
grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
roughly chopped fresh basil, plus more for garnish

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, and cook the pasta according to package directions. Before draining, reserve about 1 cup of the cooking water.

While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and zucchini and cook, stirring often, until golden brown and tender, about 5 minutes. If the veggies brown too quickly, reduce the heat to low.
Add the sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until heated through and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the drained pasta and tomatoes. Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water until the pasta mixture is silky and lightly sauced and the tomatoes are warmed through. Add another 1/4 cup or more of the water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Remove the skillet from the heat. Stir in the Parmesan, basil, and lemon zest. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve in bowls and top with more Parmesan and basil, as desired.

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower Power Salad
instructions: Arrange a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 425°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and lightly coat with nonstick spray.

Place the cauliflower florets in a large bowl. Add olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper, and toss to coat. Spread in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet and roast, turning halfway through, until golden and tender, 23 to 25 minutes.
To make the dressing, combine olive oil, lemon juice, basil, Dijon mustard, honey, and garlic in a bowl and whisk until blended. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

To assemble the salad, arrange the arugula in a large shallow bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of dressing and toss to combine. Top with eggs, tomatoes, olives, feta cheese, and warm cauliflower. Serve with remaining dressing on the side and garnish with almonds if desired.

recipes.name: Simple Greek Salad

ingredients.name: English cucumber
ingredients.proportion: 1, halved and cut into thin half moons

instructions: Place the red onion in a bowl with 1 cup ice water and 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar. Soak for about 15 minutes to mellow the flavor, then drain.
In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, olives, dill, and drained red onion. Stir until well combined.
To make the dressing, whisk together the olive oil, red wine vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, and dried oregano. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Arrange the salad greens in a large bowl and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of dressing. Add the vegetable mixture and toss gently with the remaining dressing. Top with feta cheese and garnish with additional dill and oregano as desired.

recipes.name: Apple-Celery Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: cooked boneless, skinless chicken breast (or rotisserie chicken)

instructions: Place the chicken, celery, apple, green onion, dill, and lemon zest in a large bowl and stir to combine.
Add the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, and apple cider vinegar, and mix until evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve as desired.

recipes.name: Harvest Crunch Kale & Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts, trimmed and thinly sliced

instructions: Place the kale in a large bowl. Add the olive oil and a pinch of kosher salt, and massage with your hands until the leaves soften, about 1 minute.
Add the Brussels sprouts, chicken, and grapes, and toss to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, shallot, maple syrup, and Dijon mustard to make the dressing. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to coat evenly. Divide among four bowls and top with feta cheese and macadamia nuts.

recipes.name: Citrus-Berry Ricotta Parfaits
instructions: Place the ricotta, maple syrup, orange juice, and orange zest in a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed.

To assemble the parfaits, place 1 crushed gingersnap cookie in the bottom of each of 4 glasses. Add about 1/4 cup ricotta mixture, then layer with about 1/4 cup berries. Top with another 1/4 cup ricotta, followed by a second crushed gingersnap cookie and a sprinkle of orange zest.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to serve.

recipes.name: Crispy Rice Cereal Treats
instructions: Spray an 8x8-inch baking dish or pan with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.
Heat a medium saucepan over low heat. Add the coconut flakes and toast, stirring constantly, until golden and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl to cool.
Add the butter to the same saucepan and melt over low heat. Add the marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat and stir in the puffed rice cereal until well coated. Stir in 1/4 cup of the white chocolate chips and the toasted coconut until combined.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared pan and press gently and evenly into the pan using a buttered spatula or wax paper.
Place the remaining 1/4 cup white chocolate chips and the oil in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until melted. Drizzle over the bars.
Let cool completely, then cut into squares and serve.

recipes.name: Carob Chip Cranberry Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or foil and lightly coat with nonstick spray.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat the butter and oil until creamy. Add the granulated sugar and brown sugar and beat until well combined. Add the egg and vanilla extract and beat until smooth.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture until fully incorporated. Stir in the carob chips and dried cranberries.
Roll the dough into 1 1/2-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on the prepared baking sheets. For flatter cookies, gently press down the dough balls.
Bake one sheet at a time for 10 to 12 minutes, until edges are lightly golden and centers are set. Cool on the baking sheet briefly, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Cinnamon Bars
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly coat an 8x8-inch baking dish or pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, pumpkin purée, granulated sugar, brown sugar, oil, and vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, and baking soda.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for 23 to 25 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool completely before slicing and dust with powdered sugar if desired.

recipes.name: Carob Cupcakes with Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Line 12 muffin cups with cupcake liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, sugar, applesauce, oil, milk, and vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, carob powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.

Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool slightly, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
To make the frosting, beat together the cream cheese, powdered sugar, carob powder, and vanilla extract until smooth. Chill briefly if needed to firm up.
Spread the frosting evenly over the cooled cupcakes and serve.

recipes.name: Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter and Strawberries
instructions: Spread peanut butter evenly over the rice cakes.
Top with sliced strawberries and serve.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Feta
instructions: Toast the bread.
Mash and spread avocado over the toast.
Top with crumbled feta and serve.

recipes.name: Trail Mix Snack
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix well and serve.

recipes.name: Almond Butter Apple Snack
instructions: Slice the apple.
Serve with almond butter for dipping.

recipes.name: Hummus with Bell Pepper
instructions: Slice the bell pepper.
Serve with hummus for dipping.
